description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the AWS Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations service. It specifies method signatures for various API calls related to application components, assessments, servers, and strategies, enabling asynchronous and synchronous operations.

classes.name: MigrationHubStrategyRecommendationsClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for the AWS Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations API, extending the generic AwsClient class and providing specific method signatures for the service.

methods.name: getApplicationComponentDetailsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about application components.

methods.name: getApplicationComponentStrategiesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves strategies for application components.

methods.description: Gets details of an import file task.

methods.name: getLatestAssessmentIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the latest assessment ID.

methods.name: getPortfolioSummary
